chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: For you, Lord, I don run go for protection. Make I no ever shame. Save me for your righteousness.
Bend your ear to me. Rescue me quick. Be my rock of refuge, strong fortress to save me.
Because you be my rock and my fortress. For your name sake, lead me and guide me.
Pull me out of di net wey dem hide for me, because you be my stronghold.
Into your hand I commit my spirit. You don redeem me, Lord, God of truth.
I hate dem wey dey hold empty idols, but I dey trust di Lord.
I go be glad and rejoice for your faithful love, because you don see my suffering. You don know my soul for troubles.
You no shut me inside di hand of di enemy. You don set my feet for wide place.
Have mercy on me, Lord, because I dey for trouble. My eye dey waste away with grief, yes, my soul and my body.
Because my life dey finish for sorrow and my years for sighing. My strength dey fail because of my sin and my bones dey waste away.
Because of all my enemies, I don become shame, especially to my neighbors, and fear to my friends. Dem wey see me for street dey run from me.
Dem don forget me like dead person wey nobody remember. I be like broken pot.
Because I don hear di whispering of many, terror dey every side, as dem dey plan together against me. Dem plan to take my life.
But I trust you, Lord. I talk say, “You be my God.”
My times dey your hand. Rescue me from di hand of my enemies and from dem wey dey chase me.
Make your face shine on your servant. Save me for your faithful love.
Make I no shame, Lord, because I don call you. Make di wicked shame. Make dem dey quiet for Sheol.
Make di lying lips dey silent, wey dey talk hard things against di righteous with pride and contempt.
Oh how great your goodness dey, wey you don store for dem wey fear you, wey you don do for dem wey run go you for protection, before di pikin dem of men!
You go hide dem for di secret place of your presence from di plots of man. You go keep dem secretly inside shelter from di fight of tongues.
Blessed be di Lord, because e don show me im wonderful faithful love for strong city.
As for me, I talk for my hurry say, “Dem don cut me off from your eyes.” Even so you hear di voice of my begging when I cry to you.
Love di Lord, all una im holy ones! Di Lord dey keep di faithful, and e dey pay back di proud person fully.
Be strong, and make your heart take courage, all una wey dey wait for di Lord.
Blessed na di one wey dem don forgive im disobedience, wey dem don cover im sin.
Blessed na di man wey di Lord no count im sin against, and wey no deceit dey im spirit.
When I keep quiet, my bones waste away through my groaning all day long.
Because day and night your hand heavy on me. My strength don dry up like for summer heat. Selah.
I admit my sin to you and I no hide my wrong. I talk say, “I go confess my disobedience to di Lord,” and you forgive di guilt of my sin. Selah.
So make every godly person pray to you for time wey dem fit find you. Sure sure when big floods rise, dem no go reach am.
You be my hiding place. You go keep me from trouble. You go surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
“I go instruct you and teach you for di way wey you go waka. I go advise you with my eye on you.
No be like horse or mule, wey no get understanding, wey dem must control with bit and bridle, or dem no go come near you.”
Di wicked get plenty sorrows, but faithful love go surround di one wey trust di Lord.
Be glad for di Lord and rejoice, una righteous! Shout for joy, all una wey get honest heart!
Rejoice for di Lord, una righteous! Praise dey fit di upright.
Give thanks to di Lord with harp. Sing praises to am with lyre of ten strings.
Sing to am new song. Play skillfully with loud shout.
Because di word of di Lord dey right, and all im work dey faithful.
E love righteousness and justice. Di earth full of di faithful love of di Lord.
By di word of di Lord, dem make di heavens, and all dem army by di breath of im mouth.
E gather di waters of di sea together like heap. E put di deeps for storehouses.
Make all di earth fear di Lord. Make all di people of di world stand in awe of am.
Because e talk, and e happen. E command, and e stand firm.
Di Lord bring di plans of di nations to nothing. E make di plans of di peoples no work.
Di plan of di Lord dey stand forever, di thoughts of im heart to all generations.
Blessed na di nation wey im God na di Lord, di people wey e don choose for im own inheritance.
Di Lord dey look from heaven. E dey see all di pikin dem of men.
From di place where e dey stay, e dey look on all di people of di earth,
e wey dey form dem heart all alike, wey dey consider all dem works.
No king dey saved by im big army. Strong man no dey delivered by im great strength.
Horse na vain hope for victory. E no go deliver by im great strength.
Look, di eye of di Lord dey on dem wey fear am, on dem wey hope for im faithful love,
to deliver dem soul from death and keep dem alive for famine.
Our soul dey wait for di Lord. E be our help and our shield.
Because our heart go rejoice for am, because we trust im holy name.
Make your faithful love, Lord, dey on us, as we dey hope for you.

chapters.title: By David, when e change im behavior before Abimelech, wey drive am away and e go.

verses.text: I go bless di Lord at all times. Im praise go always dey my mouth.
My soul go boast for di Lord. Di humble go hear am and rejoice.
Oh magnify di Lord with me. Make we lift up im name together.
I look for di Lord, and e answer me, and e deliver me from all my fears.
Dem look to am and dem shine. Dem face no go ever shame.
Dis poor man cry, and di Lord hear am and save am out of all im troubles.
Di angel of di Lord dey camp round dem wey fear am, and e dey deliver dem.
Oh taste and see say di Lord good. Blessed na di man wey run go am for protection.
Oh fear di Lord, una im holy ones, because nothing dey lack for dem wey fear am.
Di young lions dey lack and suffer hunger, but dem wey look for di Lord no go lack any good thing.
Come, una pikin dem, listen to me. I go teach una di fear of di Lord.
Who be di man wey want life and love many days, say e fit see good?
Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good. Seek peace and chase am.
Di eyes of di Lord dey on di righteous. Im ears dey open to dem cry.
Di face of di Lord dey against dem wey do evil, to cut off di memory of dem from di earth.
Di righteous cry, and di Lord hear, and e deliver dem out of all dem troubles.
Di Lord dey near to dem wey get broken heart, and e dey save dem wey get crushed spirit.
Di righteous get plenty troubles, but di Lord dey deliver am out of all of dem.
E dey keep all im bones. None of dem go break.
Evil go kill di wicked. Dem wey hate di righteous go suffer for dem guilt.
Di Lord dey redeem di soul of im servants. None of dem wey run go am for protection go suffer for guilt.
Contend, Lord, with dem wey contend with me. Fight against dem wey fight me.
Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up to help me.
Draw out spear and battle axe against dem wey chase me. Tell my soul, “I be your salvation.”
Make dem wey dey look for my soul shame and disgrace. Make dem wey plan my hurt turn back and confuse.
Make dem be like chaff before di wind, with di angel of di Lord dey drive dem on.
Make dem way dark and slippery, with di angel of di Lord dey chase dem.
Because dem hide dem net for me for no reason. Dem dig pit for my soul for no reason.
Make destruction come on am sudden sudden. Make di net wey e hide catch am. Make e fall inside dat destruction.
My soul go rejoice for di Lord. E go be glad for im salvation.
All my bones go talk say, “Lord, who be like you, wey dey deliver di poor from am wey strong pass am, yes, di poor and needy from am wey rob am?”
Wicked witnesses dey rise up. Dem dey ask me things wey I no know.
Dem dey pay me evil for good, to make my soul dey sorrow.
But as for me, when dem sick, my clothing na sackcloth. I humble my soul with fasting. My prayer dey return to my own chest.
I behave as if e be my friend or my brother. I bow down in mourning, like person wey dey mourn im mama.
But when I stumble, dem rejoice and gather together. Attackers gather against me, and I no know. Dem tear me and no stop.
Like godless mockers for feasts, dem gnash dem teeth at me.
Lord, how long you go look on? Rescue my soul from dem destruction, my precious life from di lions.
I go give you thanks for di great assembly. I go praise you among plenty people.
No let dem wey be my enemies for no reason rejoice over me. No let dem wey hate me without cause wink with di eye.
Because dem no dey speak peace, but dem dey plan deceitful words against dem wey dey quiet for di land.
Yes, dem open dem mouth wide against me. Dem talk say, “Aha! Aha! Our eyes don see am!”
You don see am, Lord. No keep silent. Lord, no dey far from me.
Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God and my Lord, to my cause!
Judge me, Lord my God, according to your righteousness. No let dem rejoice over me.
No let dem talk for dem heart say, “Aha! Na wetin we want!” No let dem talk say, “We don swallow am up.”
Make dem shame and confuse together, dem wey rejoice at my hurt. Make dem wey lift dem self up against me clothe dem self with shame and dishonor.
Make dem shout for joy and rejoice, dem wey favor my righteous cause. Yes, make dem always talk say, “Make di Lord dey magnified, wey enjoy di peace of im servant.”
My tongue go talk about your righteousness and your praise all day long.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By David, di servant of di Lord.

verses.text: Transgression talk to di wicked deep inside im heart. Fear of God no dey before im eyes.
Because e flatter imself for im own eyes, so im sin no go dey found out and hated.
Di words of im mouth na wickedness and deceit. E don stop to dey wise and to do good.
E dey plan wickedness for im bed. E set imself for way wey no good. E no dey hate evil.
Your faithful love, Lord, reach to di heavens. Your faithfulness reach to di skies.
Your righteousness dey like di mighty mountains. Your judgments dey like di great deep. Lord, you dey preserve man and animal.
How precious your faithful love dey, God! Di pikin dem of men dey take refuge under di shadow of your wings.
Dem go dey satisfied with di abundance of your house. You go give dem drink from di river of your pleasures.
Because with you na di fountain of life. For your light we go see light.
Oh continue your faithful love to dem wey know you, and your righteousness to di upright for heart.
No let di foot of pride come against me. No let di hand of di wicked drive me away.
Dere di workers of iniquity don fall. Dem don throw dem down, and dem no fit rise.
No fret because of evildoers, and no envy dem wey do wrong.
Because dem go soon cut down like di grass and wither like di green herb.
Trust di Lord and do good. Dwell for di land and enjoy safe pasture.
Delight yourself also for di Lord, and e go give you di desires of your heart.
Commit your way to di Lord. Trust am also, and e go do am.
E go bring out your righteousness as di light and your justice as di noonday.
Rest for di Lord and wait patiently for am. No fret because of am wey prosper for im way, because of di man wey dey carry out wicked plans.
Stop anger and leave rage. No fret, e only lead to evil.
Because evildoers go cut off, but dem wey wait for di Lord go inherit di land.
Just small while, and di wicked no go dey again. Yes, you go look well for im place, and e no go dey.
But di humble go inherit di land and go delight dem self for plenty peace.
Di wicked dey plot against di righteous and dey gnash im teeth at am.
Di Lord go laugh at am, because e see say im day dey come.
Di wicked don draw out di sword and bend dem bow to bring down di poor and needy, to kill dem wey dey upright.
Dem sword go enter dem own heart, and dem bows go break.
Di small wey di righteous get better pass di riches of many wicked.
Because di arms of di wicked go break, but di Lord dey uphold di righteous.
Di Lord know di days of di blameless. Dem inheritance go last forever.
Dem no go shame for di time of evil. For days of famine dem go dey satisfied.
But di wicked go perish. Di enemies of di Lord go be like di glory of di meadows. Dem go vanish, vanish like smoke.
Di wicked dey borrow and no dey pay back, but di righteous dey show mercy and dey give.
Because dem wey im bless go inherit di land, and dem wey im curse go cut off.
Di Lord dey direct di steps of good man, and e delight for im way.
Though e fall, e no go fall down completely, because di Lord dey uphold am with im hand.
I don be young, and now I don old, yet I never see di righteous forsaken or im pikin dem dey beg bread.
All di day e dey show mercy and lend, and im pikin dem go be blessing.
Turn from evil and do good, and dwell forever.
Because di Lord love justice and no go forsake im faithful ones. Dem go preserve forever, but di pikin dem of di wicked go cut off.
Di righteous go inherit di land and dwell for am forever.
Di mouth of di righteous dey speak wisdom, and im tongue dey talk justice.
Di law of im God dey im heart. None of im steps go slip.
Di wicked dey watch di righteous and dey seek to kill am.
Di Lord no go leave am for im hand, or condemn am when dem dey judge am.
Wait for di Lord and keep im way, and e go lift you up to inherit di land. When dem cut off di wicked, you go see am.
I don see di wicked for great power, spreading imself like green tree for im native soil.
But e pass away, and look, e no dey again. Yes, I look for am, but I no fit find am.
Mark di perfect man and look di upright, because di future of dat man na peace.
But transgressors go destroyed together. Di future of di wicked go cut off.
But di salvation of di righteous dey from di Lord. E be dem stronghold for time of trouble.
Di Lord dey help dem and rescue dem. E dey rescue dem from di wicked and save dem, because dem take refuge for am.

chapters.title: A Psalm by David. To bring to remembrance.

verses.text: Lord, no rebuke me for your anger, and no punish me for your fury.
Because your arrows don sink deep inside me, and your hand don press me down.
No health dey my flesh because of your indignation. No peace dey my bones because of my sin.
Because my iniquities don pass over my head. Dem be like heavy load, too heavy for me.
My wounds smell and fester because of my foolishness.
I dey bent and bowed down greatly. I dey mourn all day long.
Because my loins full of burning, and no health dey my flesh.
I dey faint and broken well well. I dey groan because of di disturbance of my heart.
Lord, all my desire dey before you. My groaning no hide from you.
My heart dey pound. My strength don leave me. As for di light of my eyes, e don go from me too.
My friends and my neighbors stand far from my plague. My relatives dey stand far away.
Dem wey seek my life dey lay snares. Dem wey want my hurt dey talk wicked things and plan deceit all day long.
But I, like deaf man, no dey hear. I be like dumb man wey no dey open im mouth.
Yes, I be like man wey no dey hear, and for im mouth no argument dey.
Because I dey hope for you, Lord. You go answer, Lord my God.
Because I talk say, “No make dem rejoice over me, dem wey dey lift dem self up against me when my foot slip.”
Because I ready to fall, and my pain dey always before me.
Because I go confess my iniquity. I dey sorry for my sin.
But my enemies dey lively and strong. Dem wey hate me wrongly don increase.
Dem wey pay evil for good dey oppose me, because I follow wetin good.
No forsake me, Lord. My God, no dey far from me.
Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: I talk say, “I go watch my ways, so dat I no go sin with my tongue. I go put bridle on my mouth while di wicked dey before me.”
I dey dumb with silence. I keep quiet, even from good, and my sorrow stir up.
My heart hot inside me. As I dey think, fire burn. Den I talk with my tongue:
“Lord, make me know my end and di measure of my days, wetin e be. Make I know how frail I be.
Look, you don make my days like hand width, and my lifetime be like nothing before you. Sure sure every man for im best state na only breath. Selah.
Sure sure every man dey waka like shadow. Sure sure dem dey busy for nothing. E dey gather riches and no know who go gather dem.
Now, Lord, wetin I dey wait for? My hope dey for you.
Deliver me from all my transgressions. No make me be shame of di foolish.
I dey dumb. I no open my mouth, because na you do am.
Remove your stroke from me. I dey finish by di blow of your hand.
When you correct man with rebukes for iniquity, you dey make im beauty melt away like moth. Sure sure every man na only breath. Selah.
Hear my prayer, Lord, and listen to my cry. No keep quiet at my tears, because I be stranger with you, settler like all my papa dem.
Look away from me, so dat I go smile again, before I go and I no dey again.”

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: I wait patiently for di Lord. E turn to me and hear my cry.
E bring me up also out of horrible pit, out of di miry clay. E set my feet on rock and make my steps firm.
E put new song for my mouth, praise to our God. Plenty go see am and fear and go trust di Lord.
Blessed na di man wey make di Lord im trust, and no turn to di proud, or to dem wey turn aside to lies.
Lord my God, you don do plenty wonderful works and your thoughts toward us. Nobody fit compare with you. If I wan declare and talk about dem, dem pass number.
You no delight for sacrifice and offering. You don open my ears. You no demand burnt offering and sin offering.
Den I talk say, “Look, I don come. For di scroll of di book e dey written about me.
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law dey inside my heart.”
I don proclaim di good news of righteousness for di great assembly. Look, I no go seal my lips. Lord, you know.
I no hide your righteousness inside my heart. I don declare your faithfulness and your salvation. I no conceal your faithful love and your truth from di great assembly.
Lord, no hold back your tender mercies from me. Make your faithful love and your truth always keep me.
Because troubles without number don surround me. My iniquities don catch me, so dat I no fit see. Dem plenty pass di hairs of my head, and my heart don fail me.
Be pleased, Lord, to deliver me. Hurry, Lord, to help me.
Make dem shame and confuse together, dem wey dey seek my soul to destroy am. Make dem turn back and dishonored, dem wey delight for my hurt.
Make dem be desolate by reason of dem shame, dem wey talk to me say, “Aha! Aha!”
Make all dem wey seek you rejoice and be glad for you. Make dem wey love your salvation always talk say, “Di Lord dey magnified!”
But I dey poor and needy. Di Lord dey think about me. You be my help and my deliverer. No delay, my God.
